resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's three co-founders decide whether the January price increase is going ahead, and tell the team, before the all-hands on the 18th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that, before 2026-12-18T10:00:00-08:00, the three co-founders have collectively decided whether the January price increase is going ahead and have communicated that decision to the team (e.g., via an announcement at the all-hands or a prior message). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
